## Purpose

 Fixes RFC [#56816 ](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/56816)

  Add a watchdog mechanism to vLLM V1 to automatically capture all-thread stack
  traces when the engine or worker process stops making progress, making it easier
  to diagnose hangs and deadlocks.

  - **New `vllm/utils/watch_dog.py`**: introduces the `WatchDog` class. A background
    daemon thread monitors a heartbeat (`feed()`); if the heartbeat is not refreshed
    within a timeout (default 300s, checked every 10s), it dumps the stack traces of
    all threads via `faulthandler` into a per-process log file
    (`VLLM_STACK_DUMP_for_<name>_<pid>.log`). Repeated timeouts without an intervening
    feed are logged only once. Provides `feed()` / `dump_stack()` / `start()` /
    `stop()` and a process-wide singleton `get_watch_dog()`.
  - **EngineCoreProc**: creates and starts a watchdog named `engine` after startup and
    feeds it while processing the input queue and before each engine step. The input
    queue `get()` now uses `timeout=5` so the loop stays responsive while preserving
    the original blocking semantics. The shutdown signal handler dumps all thread
    stacks for diagnosis.
  - **WorkerProc** (multiproc executor): likewise creates and starts a watchdog named
    `worker` and feeds it before executing every worker method; its signal handler
    dumps all thread stacks.
  - **MessageQueue** (`shm_broadcast`): feeds the watchdog while spin-waiting for a
    block to be written, so busy-waiting readers do not trigger false timeouts.
  - **`VllmConfig.temp_log_dir()`**: extract the per-instance log directory computation
    out of `enable_trace_function_call_for_thread()` into a reusable method so the
    watchdog writes into the same instance log directory.

  ## Test Plan & Result

### Test Qwen3-8B by TP 1:

- Launch vllm:

```
vllm serve /mnt/weight/Qwen3-8B/   --tensor-parallel-size 1    --gpu_memory_utilization 0.80   --max_num_seqs 32   --served_model_name qwen    --dtype float16  --additional-config '{"ascend_compilation_config": {"fuse_norm_quant": false}}' --enforce-eager --max_model_len 20480 --no-enable-prefix-caching
```

- Construct feed timeout by patching
- Dump result:

```
(EngineCore pid=842) INFO 09-11 16:19:51 [watch_dog.py:61] Call stack dumped to /root/vllm/dump/VLLM_STACK_DUMP_for_engine_0_842.log due to feed timeout
```

### Test Qwen3-8B by TP 2:
- launch vllm:

```
vllm serve /mnt/weight/Qwen3-8B/   --tensor-parallel-size 2    --gpu_memory_utilization 0.80   --max_num_seqs 32   --served_model_name qwen    --dtype float16  --additional-config '{"ascend_compilation_config": {"fuse_norm_quant": false}}' --enforce-eager --max_model_len 20480 --no-enable-prefix-caching
```

- Construct feed timeout by patching
- Dump result:

```
(EngineCore pid=1694) INFO 09-11 16:40:39 [watch_dog.py:61] Call stack dumped to /root/vllm/dump/VLLM_STACK_DUMP_for_engine_0_1694.log due to feed timeout
(Worker_TP1 pid=1722) INFO 09-11 16:40:44 [watch_dog.py:61] Call stack dumped to /root/vllm/dump/VLLM_STACK_DUMP_for_worker-1_1722.log due to feed timeout
(Worker_TP0 pid=1721) INFO 09-11 16:40:47 [watch_dog.py:61] Call stack dumped to /root/vllm/dump/VLLM_STACK_DUMP_for_worker-0_1721.log due to feed timeout
```

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+
+from pydantic import Field
+
+from vllm.config.utils import config
+
+_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 300
+_DEFAULT_CHECK_INTERVAL = 10
+
+
+@config
+class WatchdogConfig:
+    """Configuration for the stack-dump watchdog.
+
+    The watchdog runs a background thread that periodically checks whether the
+    main thread has fed it in time. If not, it dumps the stack traces of all
+    threads to a dump file for debugging.
+    """
+
+    timeout: int = Field(default=_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT, gt=0)
+    """Timeout in seconds after which the watchdog considers the process to be
+    stuck and dumps stack traces. Must be greater than 0."""
+
+    check_interval: int = Field(default=_DEFAULT_CHECK_INTERVAL, gt=0)
+    """Interval in seconds at which the watchdog checks for feed timeouts."""
